verdict.rationale: The pack shows Svelte lets you put reactive logic in .svelte.js/.svelte.ts modules that behave like plain JS. That is a building block for DOM-free testing, not a documented unit-testing capability. Nothing in the pack covers testing runes outside a component, test tooling, or a testing guide, and the only community comment on testing reports the lack of a clear unit testing solution or docs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit test my reactive state and logic without needing to render the DOM
